_README: Where the site's navigation points, in one place. Edit, then run:
which rewrites the header, footer and head of every page in site/, every link
marked data-dest="<name>" in page content, and the generated block of
site/_redirects. `python3 scripts/build.py --check` fails if any page has
drifted from these values, or links to a destination without data-dest.
destinations: the separate Idlery sites the navigation links straight to.
Products, Simulations and Portfolio are their own sites; idlery.com does not
host copies of them. A destination may be offline until that site is set up.
retired_paths: addresses idlery.com used to serve itself. Each gets a forced
301 to its destination, with and without the trailing slash, so old links follow.
